source.upstream_terms: PhysX-Mobility is derived from PartNet-Mobility; its release license does not supersede applicable PartNet-Mobility and ShapeNet terms. The paired asset use is non-commercial research evaluation.

selection.ranking_rule: within each exact PartNet-Mobility category in the PhysX/PartNet common-ID pool, ascending rank hash then numeric dataset_id; take six
selection.failure_policy: retain every frozen ID in the requested denominator; never replace unavailable, parse-failed, invalid, or unscorable assets

ontology_alignment_views.primary_raw_name_view: raw PhysX-Mobility URDF link names only
ontology_alignment_views.metadata_assisted_sensitivity: prediction-side finaljson part names recovered through exact visual-mesh basename identity; package annotations are not reference hierarchy gold

evaluation.unsupported_joint_policy: report every joint type outside fixed/revolute/continuous/prismatic/planar/floating separately; never silently reclassify it

claim_boundary.dataset_role: paired derivative curated released-dataset reference, not a generated-method baseline and not an independent corroborating dataset
claim_boundary.structure: package-level URDF structural validity and representation diagnostics
claim_boundary.ontology: raw-name semantic recoverability and induced PartNet-ontology alignment proxy, not instance-level kinematic correctness
claim_boundary.paired_interpretation: same-ID PhysX-Mobility versus PartNet-Mobility representation-change audit
